text: Requesting that Scarborough Community Council re-open Delegated Item SC23.26.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Re-opened Delegated Item SC23.26, titled "All-Way Stop Control Review - Fundy Bay Boulevard and Seagrave Crescent (North Intersection). 2. Rescinded Recommendation 1 of the decision Item SC23.26. 3. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Fundy Bay Boulevard and Seagrave Crescent (south intersection).
